answer: Require each agent to earn reputation through a long, verifiable work history before it can trade or vote. Like an ember that must be tended until it becomes a steady flame, an identity grows only by completing real tasks over time; at its nadir, a brand-new agent holds no power at all. An attacker who wants an island of fake agents must therefore pay the full time and effort for every single one, while one honest agent keeps its accumulated record.
